name_reason: Compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention: data_fd2_ prefix + battle core-table domain + descriptor ai_best_physical_target_y. The _y suffix is a semantic axis label (the Y tile coordinate), not Ghidra address residue (address is 0x53c47, not _y). Part of the well-formed sibling group _x/_y/_idx/_score. Name reflects data type (a scalar coordinate slot).
purpose: Enemy-AI physical-attack scoring scratchpad: holds the tile Y coordinate of the best-scoring attack candidate position chosen by fd2_ai_score_physical_attack, later consumed by fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack.
logic_summary: Written by fd2_ai_score_physical_attack @0x144E6 (MOV [0x53C47],EAX) inside the per-candidate-tile loop: when a candidate tile beats the running best (score_class > best score, or equal score with higher tiebreak damage) its candidate_y is stored as a full dword. candidate_y originates as a zero-extended byte tile coordinate (MOVZX EAX,byte ptr[pos+1]). Read by fd2_execute_ai_physical_attack @0x154BA and passed to fd2_ai_walk_to_target_tile to move the attacker to the chosen tile. Second member of the 4-slot ai_best_physical_* result group (x @0x53C43, y @0x53C47, idx @0x53C4B, score @0x53C4F).
datatype: uint32 (dword, 4 bytes); zero-init BSS scalar in .object2
element_semantics: Unsigned battle-map tile Y coordinate (board row index). Source value is a single byte zero-extended into the 4-byte slot; valid range is the battle map height, not a fixed domain ID.
notes: src comment block (btl_aisc.c lines 679-686) already precise, correct, ASCII-only, and consistent with disassembly (writer @0x144E6, reader @0x154BA verified) -> comment kept, btl_aisc.c not edited for the comment. Ghidra data documentation was in PRE_COMMENT with empty PLATE (mixed group state: sibling 0x53c43 had both PLATE+PRE; idx/score had only PRE). Per project_ghidra_data_plate_mechanism, data docs belong in PLATE_COMMENT: populated PLATE_COMMENT (src-aligned, concise, 685 chars) via run_script_inline cu.setComment(PLATE_COMMENT,...) and cleared the stale duplicate PRE_COMMENT. is_const=false: game-side WRITE xref exists (fd2_ai_score_physical_attack). No logic touched.
